verify.label: which tables exist
verify.sql: SELECT to_regclass('trial_a') IS NOT NULL AS a_exists, to_regclass('trial_b') IS NOT NULL AS b_exists

verify.label: columns of trial_a
verify.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default, is_identity, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'trial_a' ORDER BY ordinal_position
